title: C++: Web Router (Simulated)
description: Build a simple HTTP router that maps URL paths to handler functions.

steps.title: Router
steps.description: Create a Router class that stores path->handler mappings. Implement void get(string path, function<void()> handler) and void dispatch(string path). Test: route '/' prints 'Home', '/about' prints 'About', '/api' prints 'API'.
hints: dispatch: find route, call handler if found, else 404.
